Website

Landing pages.

The Sexual health landing page (Option A, approved by Avi), then LP 01: a landing page for a Meta (Facebook and Instagram) campaign for Combo, in two concepts with different marketing strategies, being rebuilt for unifiedmeds as part of the Sexual health landing-page work. Every landing page uses the website's header rule, components and footer.

Sexual healthLP 01 conceptsCompliance statusWhat changes for unifiedmeds

Sexual health · Option A, "The guided story".

The first unifiedmeds landing page, for the Sexual health campaign. Mobile first, built only from the tokens and components, with the landing-page motion rule (R-104), the header logo rule (R-103) and the one footer (R-114).

Approved by Avi
  • Sticky header with Get started; the capsule draws once in the hero; "[charge line · operations]" under the hero button (R-62).
  • How it works: the one four-step wording (q132); the capsule fills step by step as you scroll.
  • Daily or As needed switch, a video slot, treatments with the provider-approval line, reviews in the prototype format (DEMO ONLY, "Member · age", R-67), provider, plan and price, FAQ, safety.
  • No Hair loss, Longevity or Reviews links in the header or footer until they launch and legal approves.
  • Copy, prices, provider and reviews are placeholders until legal and operations approve them.
Open the landing page
Current · R-117

A category's landing page takes its category colour for its dark bands: Sexual health Deep Teal, Longevity Forest, Hair loss Sky (with Deep Teal text and buttons). On the Sexual health page both dark bands, the provider band and the closing call, are Deep Teal, and they never touch (R-119). See Category colours.

LP 01 · Combo · two concepts.

Source: Figma file LP_01_Cl (stage 2) and the brief in the LP_01 folder. One goal per page: a visitor from an ad gets what he needs and starts the assessment.

Being rebuilt

The two concepts are rebuilt in the unifiedmeds look (name, capsule seal, rounded-rectangle buttons, the current tokens) before they are shown here. The structure, the strategy of each concept and the compliance work below carry over.
